task_prompt: A scene contains 10 shapes of various types (rectangles, ellipses, polygons) scattered across the canvas. 5 are red and 5 are blue. The agent must delete all 5 red shapes and leave all 5 blue shapes intact.

text: I'll help you delete all the red shapes while leaving the blue shapes intact. Let me first take a closer look at the current screen to identify all the shapes.

I can see a canvas with some shapes visible. I can see:
- A red rectangle in the center
- Part of a red circle on the right edge
- Part of a blue shape at the bottom

I need to see the full canvas to locate all 10 shapes. Let me first expand the "scene" layer in the Layers panel to see all the shapes listed, or scroll the canvas to see all shapes.

Good, I clicked on the "scene" layer and it's now selected. I can see the scene properties on the right. I need to expand the scene layer to see all the child shapes. Let me click on the arrow/triangle next to "scene" to expand it.

Perfect! The scene layer is now expanded and I can see all 10 shapes listed:

**Blue shapes (5):**
- blue_05
- blue_04
- blue_03
- blue_02
- blue_01

**Red shapes (5):**
- red_05
- red_04
- red_03
- red_02
- red_01

I need to delete all 5 red shapes and leave the blue ones intact. I'll start by selecting and deleting the first red shape (red_01).

Good! I've selected red_01 (it's now highlighted in blue in the layers panel and shown selected on the canvas with selection handles). I can see it's a red rectangle. Now I'll delete it by pressing the Delete key.

Excellent! red_01 has been deleted. I can see in the layers panel that it's no longer listed. The red rectangle that was in the center of the canvas is gone. Now I need to delete the remaining 4 red shapes: red_02, red_03, red_04, and red_05.

Let me select red_02 next.

Perfect! red_02 is now selected (I can see it highlighted in the layers panel and selected on the canvas - it appears to be the red circle on the right edge). The properties panel shows it has red fill (FF0000). Now I'll delete it.

Great! red_02 is deleted. I can see the red circle is no longer on the canvas and it's no longer in the layers panel. Now I have 3 more red shapes to delete: red_03, red_04, and red_05.

Let me select red_03 next.

Perfect! red_03 is now selected (highlighted in the layers panel). I can see it's positioned at x=90, y=-250, which means it's above the visible canvas area. The properties show it has red fill (FF0000) and has a "Count" of 3, suggesting it's a polygon (triangle). Now I'll delete it.
Excellent! red_03 is deleted. Now I can see in the layers panel that only 2 red shapes remain: red_04 and red_05. Let me select red_04 next.

Perfect! red_04 is now selected (highlighted in the layers panel). I can see it's at position x=375, y=100 with dimensions 110x80, and it has a red fill (FF0000). It appears to be a rectangle located outside the currently visible canvas area. Now I'll delete it.
Excellent! red_04 is deleted. Now I have only one more red shape to delete: red_05. Let me select it.

Perfect! red_05 is now selected (highlighted in the layers panel). I can see it's at position x=-330, y=190 with dimensions 100x100, and it has a red fill (FF0000). It appears to be located outside the currently visible canvas area to the left. Now I'll delete this last red shape.

Perfect! The task is complete! I have successfully deleted all 5 red shapes. Looking at the layers panel, I can now see that under the "scene" layer, only the 5 blue shapes remain:

1. blue_05
2. blue_04
3. blue_03
4. blue_02
5. blue_01

All red shapes (red_01, red_02, red_03, red_04, and red_05) have been deleted, and all blue shapes are intact. The canvas now shows only blue shapes, with part of a blue shape visible at the bottom of the canvas.
